name: Heating elements
summary: Resistance heaters: coils, rods, cartridges and plates from kettles, ovens, heaters and dryers.
uses: Cooking and water heating from a generator or big inverter
Dump load for a wind turbine or spare solar
identify: Nichrome coils in toasters, hair dryers, space heaters and clothes dryers; steel-sheathed rods in ovens, kettles and water heaters; flat pads in irons and hot plates. Watts and volts are usually stamped on the element or the appliance.
test: Measure resistance: a 1,000W element reads about 53 Ω on 230V or 14 Ω on 120V. Open means burnt out; any reading to the metal sheath means it’s shorted and unsafe.
